newsitem.title: ITALY: BASKETBALL-BOWIE LIFTS MILAN TO SIXTH VICTORY.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-BOWIE LIFTS MILAN TO SIXTH VICTORY.

text.p: American Anthony Bowie grabbed 26 points to power Italy's Stefanel Milan to a 79-66 win over former European champions Limoges of France in their group A EuroLeague basketball match on Thursday.
Milan stayed top of the group with six wins in seven games while disappointing Limoges remained bottom with two wins and five defeats.

A brilliant Bowie, backed up by veteran pivot Gregor Fucka, guided Milan to a 22-7 lead after just seven minutes but fine shooting from Gerald Glass helped Limoges slice the score to 41-34 at the half.
The Italian champions, never underestimating their rivals, regained their composure and stormed to a 20-point lead five minutes into the second half.
The imposing Fucka dominated under the boards, hauling down several key rebounds, and added 23 points. Glass was Limoges's top scorer with 16 points.
